annotations.title: Get a campaign's QR codes as a ZIP

description: Read-only. Every live link of one campaign as print-ready QR codes in one ZIP (one file per link, `<slug>-qr.svg` or .png, sorted by slug), in the workspace's QR style or a saved style (preset; get_workspace lists them as qrStyles). SVG by default (vector, for print); PNG at most 1024 px and 50 links. Returns a summary and the ZIP as an embedded file. Scans add utm_source=qr by default. Limit: 3 ZIPs a minute per workspace. For very large campaigns use Dashboard -> Links -> filter by campaign -> QR ZIP.

background.description: Background colour as hex, overrides the style

campaign.description: The links' campaign name, e.g. diwali_sale (case-insensitive, as in the dashboard's links filter)

color.description: Code colour as hex, overrides the style

logo.description: Put the app icon in the middle, overrides the style

preset.description: A saved QR style (its id from get_workspace qrStyles); color, background and logo still override it

size.description: Width and height in pixels (default 1024; PNG at most 1024)

track.description: Add utm_source=qr so scans count as the qr channel (default true)

name: get_campaign_qr_zip
title: Get a campaign's QR codes as a ZIP
